evals.prompt: Use $ip-novelty-search to find the closest prior patents for this technical solution, compare features and assess novelty.
assertions: Recognize the official ip-novelty-search identifier and enter novelty research
Do not guarantee patentability or a formal novelty-search opinion

evals.prompt: Conduct a China patent novelty search on the attached complete mechanical disclosure, using 2025-01-01 as assessment date, and deliver an HTML report.
assertions: Preserve extracted source_features and use traceable comparison_units for formal comparison
Use mixed semantic/keyword recall and save actual requests and receipts
Show filing/publication dates per document and separate date eligibility from technical disclosure
Do not combine documents for novelty; audit numbered Y groups under the CN three-step approach

evals.prompt: Assess whether this optical solution has inventive step.
assertions: With a concrete solution already supplied, ask together only for target jurisdiction and assessment date that affect conclusions
For an authorized test first, state its jurisdiction and limit conclusion strength
Do not give definite novelty/inventive-step conclusions while decisive text or dates remain unresolved

evals.prompt: Continue existing novelty research: the strongest candidate’s full text introduces new industry terminology but its key relationship remains not_mentioned.
assertions: Create feedback with source publication, affected features, triggering fact and new query
Return to step 3 for targeted mixed semantic/keyword retrieval
Compare only new documents or affected features and retain the previous judgment
The legacy name is not an installed entry point; suggest ip-novelty-search or route by the actual request

evals.prompt: Assess whether our product falls within the claims of these three active US patents.
assertions: Route to FTO or claim comparison; do not reframe implementation risk as novelty research

evals.prompt: Analyze a competitor’s patent portfolio and technology evolution over the last five years.
assertions: Do not start novelty or inventive-step assessment

evals.prompt: Review the attached novelty report for missed documents, wrong citations and overstated conclusions; do not search from scratch.
assertions: Prioritize report review unless the user subsequently requests new or continued novelty research
